issuer.name: 内蒙古伊利实业集团股份有限公司

role.name: fresh_result_isolated_preoutcome_forecaster
role.authority: Create and repair only the preoutcome enterprise-judgment contract; no formal valuation, investment action, outcome settlement, or post-outcome synthesis authority.

work_performed.judgment_first_enterprise_reconstruction: Reconstructed how the branded dairy enterprise earns money through raw-milk supply, manufacturing, product groups, distribution and cash/capital conversion; identified the primary current constraint; assessed management's product, channel, supply-chain and capital-allocation direction with bounded execution credit; and stated falsifiable countercases, owner-cash treatment, permanent-loss treatment, scenarios and directional valuation implications without formal valuation or action authority.
work_performed.supported_fact_boundary: Used only exact FY2021-FY2023 annual-report facts with PDF page citations; localized undisclosed customer, channel, organic-comparability and project-return facts rather than turning them into a whole-company UNKNOWN.

frozen_non_substitutable_settlement_axes.measure: Same-product sales volumes from the annual-report production/sales/inventory table; revenue, OCF and cash balance are not substitutes.
Same-product gross margins from the annual-report product table; revenue growth, group margin and OCF are not substitutes.

Consolidated operating cash flow less cash paid to acquire/construct fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets; it is not customer absorption, unit economics, project cash recovery, free cash flow or project IRR.
Disclosed weighted average ROE on the same listed-company/equity boundary; it is not a channel, factory, acquisition or product project return.

work_performed.review_driven_repair: Applied an exclusivity-only repair to A1 and A2: first record each affected product as LOCAL_MISMATCH and retain comparable products' local comparisons; if any product is mismatched, the aggregate result is solely PARTIAL_UNKNOWN and cannot also be SUCCESS, MIXED or FAILURE. The pre-existing three-product thresholds apply only when all three products are comparable. No company facts, judgment, threshold, A3 or A4 were changed.

isolation_attestation.attestation: The forecaster remained result-isolated. No FY2024-or-later source, metadata or result was read; no market, price, return, valuation, analyst, derived-company, prior-case-result or method material was used.

excluded_outputs: price, return, market-performance or valuation result
formal valuation range, security recommendation, maximum purchase price or investment action
post-outcome enterprise synthesis or training-effectiveness conclusion
new source acquisition, browser work or source-packet expansion
